visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of a man with shoulder-length dark hair, dressed in a green and black plaid shirt, a striped shirt, and blue trousers, standing in the middle of Old Town Square in Prague. The ground is paved with cobblestones, and the background features the twin-towered St. Nicholas Church under a gray, overcast sky. White subtitles appear at the bottom center. (2) There is a cut to a medium close-up of the man pointing toward a stone fountain with a decorative fish sculpture. He wears a brown beanie and smiles slightly at the camera. (3) A wide shot shows the square from another angle, revealing historical colorful buildings and the tall Old Town Hall clock tower. Pigeons are gathered on the cobblestones. (4) The man is seen walking through the square toward the camera while holding a yellow bottle. Pigeons fly up into the air around him as he moves. (5) The shot changes to a static wide view of a long street lined with classical architecture, leading to a large domed building at the end. The sun is visible through the hazy sky. (6) A selfie-style close-up shows the man's face as he covers his right eye with his hand. (7) He stands in front of the Jan Hus Memorial monument, flashing a peace sign. (8) The scene shifts to the man walking through a narrow, arched cobblestone passage with various shop signs on the walls. (9) Returning to the square, the man spins around with his arms outstretched while pigeons fly nearby. (10) A night shot features an elderly street musician sitting on a chair and playing an accordion, with neon shop signs and parked scooters in the background. (11) The final shot shows the man looking out from a high tower window with iron bars, overlooking the sprawling red-roofed buildings of the city.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a creative recreation of Jay Chou's famous song 'Prague Square'. The creator travels to the actual filming locations in Prague to act out the lyrics, including visiting the Old Town Square, the fountain, and dancing among pigeons. The goal is to provide a nostalgic and fan-driven travel tribute that connects Mandopop culture with real-world travel destinations.
